tiers.name: Critical Failure
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}} tries the action and it goes wrong in front of everyone, the kind of disaster the whole camp will still be telling stories about at supper - if enemies are present, consider framing the failure as partly the result of an enemy's cleverness, tactics, or intervention that thwarts the attempt, rather than the player merely being inept.]

tiers.name: Failure
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}} tries to do the action, but it fails - if enemies are present, consider framing the failure as partly the result of an enemy's cleverness, tactics, or intervention that thwarts the attempt, rather than the player merely being inept.]

tiers.name: Mixed Results
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}} does the action, but it is only partially successful with mixed results.]

tiers.name: Critical Success
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}}'s action is amazingly successful, the kind of thing a crowd would pay twice to see and talk about all the way home.]
